Early Paleolithic
Middle Paleolithic
Late Paleolithic

questions.text: How did animal husbandry and dairy farming begin?
questions.text_as_printed: How did animal husbandry and dairy farming begin? (D)

answer.value:
About 12,000 years ago, there were changes in the world's environment
The temperature of the earth increased
The population of animals and birds increased
Along with these developments, animals like deer, cattle, goats, sheep, and others began to thrive in grassland regions
Humans, who earlier hunted these animals, began to understand their nature, food habits, and reproduction
Gradually, humans started capturing and domesticating some of these animals
Thus, animal husbandry and dairy farming began
